title: Patch the Night
subtitle: Offensive research. Automatic fire. One more run.

characters.name: The Hunter
characters.description: A methodical exploit hunter with a whip made of packet traces.

characters.name: The Researcher
characters.description: Reads the source. Finds the bug. Lights up the room.

characters.name: The Operator
characters.description: A red-team operator who never stops moving.

characters.name: The Reverser
characters.description: Turns corrupted memory into a perfectly controlled orbit.

characters.name: The Cryptanalyst
characters.description: Searches the keyspace until the entire night gives way.

characters.name: The Phantom
characters.description: An untracked process, already inside the kernel.

stages.name: The Attack Surface
stages.description: An exposed web perimeter. Reverse proxies disagree, endpoints leak and every 403 looks negotiable. The Breach Bell closes the scope around you.

relic.name: The Scope Ledger
relic.lore: The forgotten endpoint was in scope all along.

mechanic.name: WAF Rule Reload
mechanic.description: The cathedral bell summons a ring of fresh attack vectors.

objective.name: The Quarantined Researcher
objective.description: Break the quarantine by defeating all wardens, then recover the sealed researcher.

merchant.name: The Grey-Hat Broker
merchant.description: Trade current-run bounty for immediate power. Unspent gold can be banked after the run.

stages.briefing: scope.test has a reverse proxy, a WAF and a very optimistic threat model. Enumerate the routes. Find the parsing gap.

stages.name: The Forbidden Repository
stages.description: A source-code archive with no tenant isolation. Query floods, copied identities and deserialized objects hunt between firewall lanes.

relic.name: Source Map
relic.lore: The source map was shipped to production. Of course it was.

stages.landmarkHint: Search the archives to the west.

mechanic.name: Authorization Middleware Sweep
mechanic.description: Moving index sweeps seal two lanes. Stay in the clear corridor.

objective.name: The Redacted Maintainer
objective.description: Break the quarantine by defeating all wardens, then recover the sealed researcher.

merchant.name: The Grey-Hat Broker

stages.scope: source review / multi-tenant APIs / object ownership
stages.briefing: The repository includes the source, the secrets and the production database password in an old commit. Read carefully.

stages.name: The Exploit Foundry
stages.description: A native exploitation foundry. Heap corruption, gadget chains and race windows boil between solid allocator pillars and erupting payload vents.

relic.name: Arbitrary Write
relic.lore: You control the address. You control what gets written.

stages.landmarkHint: A crucible burns to the south.

mechanic.name: Heap Corruption Burst
mechanic.description: Three crucibles rupture around your current position. Move before they ignite.

objective.name: The Sealed Operator
objective.description: Break the quarantine by defeating all wardens, then recover the sealed researcher.

merchant.name: The Grey-Hat Broker
merchant.description: Trade current-run bounty for immediate power. Unspent gold can be banked after the run.

stages.briefing: NX is enabled. ASLR is on. The developer says the crash is harmless. Turn the primitive into a working chain.

stages.name: Ring Zero
stages.description: A fractured kernel beneath every trust boundary. TOCTOU twins, polluted prototypes and privileged processes circle gravitational faults.

relic.name: Root of Trust
relic.lore: The root of trust has misplaced its trust.

mechanic.name: Privilege Boundary Fault
mechanic.description: A kernel rift pulls you toward its damaging core. Dash clear of the fault.

objective.name: The Lost Process
objective.description: Break the quarantine by defeating all wardens, then recover the sealed researcher.

merchant.name: The Grey-Hat Broker
merchant.description: Trade current-run bounty for immediate power. Unspent gold can be banked after the run.

stages.briefing: You reached ring 0. The mitigation is another permission check. The permission check is a comment.

stages.name: The Cloud Spire
stages.description: A vertical cloud control plane above the archive. Climb through IAM boundaries, stolen service identities and metadata pivots while policy sweeps cut the ascent.
stages.landmarkHint: Climb north toward the identity beacon.

mechanic.name: IAM Policy Reconciliation
mechanic.description: Privilege boundaries sweep across the control plane. Move through the unsealed lane.

objective.name: The Quarantined Cloud Engineer
objective.description: Break the quarantine by defeating all wardens, then recover the sealed researcher.

merchant.name: The Grey-Hat Broker

stages.scope: cloud control plane / IAM boundaries / metadata services
stages.briefing: The bastion trusted the workload identity. The workload trusted the metadata service. Somewhere above, a wildcard role waits for its next assumption.

weapons.name: HTTP Desync Whip
weapons.description: Request smuggling, with reach. Sweep both sides of the parsing boundary; stand still to aim at the nearest threat.

evolution.name: Root Shell
evolution.description: A desynchronized request becomes a bidirectional root-shell lash. Bleed targets and siphon integrity.

weapons.name: SQL Needles
weapons.description: Query shards pierce the result set. Straight shots assist targets ahead; standing still selects the nearest sink.

evolution.name: Prepared Execution
evolution.description: A rapid UNION of piercing queries. Every hit is critical; the result set never ends.

weapons.name: SSTI Probe
weapons.description: A homing template probe finds the nearest sink. The server should not have evaluated that.

evolution.name: Template Takeover
evolution.description: Template context acquired. Homing probes become an explosive code-execution chain.

weapons.name: Stack Pivot
weapons.description: Orbiting stack frames turn nearby threats into controlled memory. RSP is your problem now.

evolution.name: ret2libc Carousel
evolution.description: A wider ret2libc carousel. More gadgets, more coverage, no clean stack frame left.

weapons.name: Blind Injection
weapons.description: Leave persistent tainted payloads beneath targets. No response body? The side effects are enough.

evolution.name: Second-Order Injection
evolution.description: Second-order payloads persist, drift toward their operator and expand their blast radius.

weapons.name: Heap Spray
weapons.description: Spray bouncing allocations across the arena. Eventually every address is your address.

evolution.name: Use After Free
evolution.description: Reclaim the freed allocation. Larger chunks burst into persistent heap fragments.

weapons.name: Fuzzing Storm
weapons.description: Mutate inputs until something breaks. Each crash chains a new test case into the next target.

evolution.name: Coverage Guided
evolution.description: Coverage-guided corpus expansion. Follow new edges, fork the strike, reproduce the crash.

weapons.name: ROP Cleaver
weapons.description: Lob heavy ROP gadgets in piercing arcs. Every landing is another controlled return.

evolution.name: Return Oriented
evolution.description: The whole arena is one long ROP chain. Piercing gadgets fan out in every direction.

weapons.name: Forged JWT
weapons.description: Send a forged session token through the horde and back. Trusting the header was the first mistake.

evolution.name: Session Hijack
evolution.description: Stolen sessions return faster and cut wider paths. Your identity provider has questions.

weapons.name: Kill Switch
weapons.description: Crash the visible attack surface. Early PoCs may destroy their own evidence. Reproducibility is a feature.

evolution.name: Full Disclosure
evolution.description: Full disclosure, complete evidence. Preserve every gem and pull the entire corpus to you.

weapons.name: RCE Payload
weapons.description: Your input became a command. Slow, heavy payloads explode through clustered execution sinks.

evolution.name: Interactive Shell
evolution.description: Post-exploitation at scale. Deeper piercing, larger blasts, no shell left unattended.

weapons.name: Recon Ravens
weapons.description: Send two recon familiars to enumerate a rotating patch of the attack surface. Subdomains do not find themselves.

evolution.name: Full-Spectrum Recon
evolution.description: Full-spectrum recon tracks live targets and delivers a continuous payload rain.

weapons.name: Sandbox Aegis
weapons.description: A privilege boundary with a finite charge budget. Absorb a hit, then rebuild one barrier charge after the recharge interval.

evolution.name: Unbroken Boundary
evolution.description: Mandatory access control becomes retaliation. Block real damage, briefly reject further contact, and send a counterattack through nearby threats.

weapons.name: Race-Window Lance
weapons.description: Serialize the race. A directional freeze beam rotates around the operator, holding real enemies inside its critical section without dealing damage.

evolution.name: Deterministic Horizon
evolution.description: Freeze the schedule and reclaim a bounded fraction of each target’s current integrity. Bosses resist both the freeze and the integrity cut.

passives.name: Exploit Impact
passives.description: Increase weapon damage. Turn a low-impact primitive into a finding that matters.

passives.name: Automation
passives.description: Automate the boring requests. Reduce time between every attack.

passives.name: Attack Surface
passives.description: Expand the attack surface. Reach more sinks with every payload.

passives.name: Persistence
passives.description: Persistence survives the next request. Keep payloads active longer.

passives.name: Parallel Requests
passives.description: Concurrent requests, concurrent problems. Add one projectile at levels two and five.

passives.name: Packet Velocity
passives.description: Send the next probe before the first request times out. Boost movement and projectile speed.

passives.name: Recon Scope
passives.description: Collect evidence from farther away. Screenshot or it did not happen.

passives.name: Defense in Depth
passives.description: Layer your controls. Reduce damage when the perimeter eventually fails.

passives.name: Backup Instance
passives.description: Keep a clean restore point. Increase maximum integrity.

passives.name: Source Insight
passives.description: Read the source before the documentation. Get more XP from every evidence gem.

passives.name: Entropy
passives.description: The crash was not random. Improve critical hits, treasure and upgrade choices.

passives.name: Expanded Scope
passives.description: Scope expanded. So did the threat model. More enemies and more evidence.

enemies.name: Script Imp
enemies.description: A swarm of untrusted scripts. Fragile bodies, fast propagation.

threat.name: Cross-site scripting
threat.onKill: DOM sink reached. Execution context acquired.

enemies.name: Query Golem
enemies.description: Armored query constructs absorb weak probes. Commit to a stronger payload.

threat.name: SQL injection
threat.onKill: WHERE clause bypassed. All rows are in scope.

enemies.name: Proxy Wraith
enemies.description: A server-side request that blinks through your perimeter. Watch for the pivot.

threat.name: Server-side request forgery
threat.onKill: Internal pivot complete. The perimeter was a suggestion.

enemies.name: Identity Mimic
enemies.description: One stolen identity becomes two. Breaking object ownership spawns smaller copies.

threat.name: Insecure direct object reference
threat.onKill: Object acquired. Ownership check not found.

enemies.name: Auth Knight
enemies.description: A privileged route behind a decorative access check. Read the charge windup.

threat.name: Missing authorization
threat.onKill: Access granted. Apparently 200 OK is a policy.

enemies.name: Race Twins
enemies.description: Two processes, one shared resource, no lock. Their zigzags never stay synchronized.

threat.name: Time-of-check / time-of-use
threat.onKill: Race won. The check and the use disagree.

enemies.name: Execution Crawler
enemies.description: An execution sink on legs. It keeps its distance and sends commands your way.

threat.name: OS command injection
threat.onKill: Code execution reached. Your input became a process.

enemies.name: Object Reliquary
enemies.description: A hostile object graph rebuilds script imps. Remove the gadget source before the swarm grows.

threat.name: Insecure deserialization
threat.onKill: Gadget chain complete. The object was not just data.

enemies.name: Prototype Mimic
enemies.description: Inherited poison spreads across the floor. Do not stand in the polluted prototype chain.

threat.name: Prototype pollution
threat.onKill: Prototype poisoned. Those defaults belonged to everyone.

enemies.name: The Unpatched One
enemies.description: The final privileged process. Survive its phases, read the telegraphs, take control.

threat.name: Improper privilege management
threat.onKill: Privilege boundary crossed. You own this process now.

arcana.name: Critical Thinking
arcana.description: All weapons gain +15% critical chance. Critical hits deal another +50% damage. Every finding needs a reproducible impact.

arcana.name: Responsible Disclosure
arcana.description: Every defeated vulnerability restores 0.25 health. Whip lifesteal doubles. A clean disclosure keeps the operator alive.

arcana.name: Exploit Chain
arcana.description: Projectile impacts detonate for 30% damage in a small area. One primitive is good. A chain is better.

arcana.name: Race Condition
arcana.description: Weapon hits have a 15% chance to freeze a vulnerability for one second. Suspend the thread. Win the scheduling window.

arcana.name: Return to Sender
arcana.description: Knives, bolts and fireballs ricochet twice instead of expiring at the edge. Reflected input is still your input.

arcana.name: Bug Bounty
arcana.description: Gold drops heal you, and every chest contains an extra gold reward. Impact first. Payout second.

powerUps.name: Revival
powerUps.description: Return once after a failed exploit.

ui.healDescription: Restore health and keep the build you have.
ui.goldDescription: Take gold instead of a new item.
ui.bossDescription: A privileged vulnerability has entered the scope.
ui.winText: Exploit chain complete. Scope owned. Report ready.
ui.deathText: Segmentation fault. The PoC needs one more iteration.
ui.reviveText: Checkpoint restored. Same target, better hypothesis.
ui.limitBreakDescription: Your arsenal is complete. Push one weapon beyond its limits.
ui.rescueText: Researcher recovered. The root cause was an authorization check left as a TODO.
ui.secretObjectiveText: Full chain confirmed: reconnaissance, researcher extraction and the final privilege boundary. Impact demonstrated.
ui.merchantOpenText: Grey-Hat Broker — trade run bounty for a better primitive. No duplicate reports.
ui.arcanaFlavor_critical: Every finding needs a reproducible impact.
ui.arcanaFlavor_blood: A clean disclosure keeps the operator alive.
ui.arcanaFlavor_volatile: One primitive is good. A chain is better.
ui.arcanaFlavor_frost: Suspend the thread. Win the scheduling window.
ui.arcanaFlavor_ricochet: Reflected input is still your input.
ui.scope_library: source review / multi-tenant APIs / object ownership
ui.lobbySubtitle: Enumerate. Find a primitive. Chain it. Survive the disclosure.
ui.scopeLoaded: Scope loaded. The WAF is feeling confident.
ui.chestFeed: BOUNTY TRIAGE / The impact was reproducible.
ui.deathFeed: CORE DUMPED / Repro steps need work.
ui.winFeed: SCOPE OWNED / Write the report before touching prod.
ui.researchHeading: REAL RESEARCH / FOLLOW THE VULNERABILITY CLASS
ui.inverseDescription: Double enemy health, faster and denser threats. Double gold and +20% Growth.
ui.endlessCycleText: NEW ATTACK CYCLE / the scope has expanded. Waves and broker stock reset; threat pressure rises.
ui.stageItemOpen: The guardian fell. Recover the exposed artifact.
ui.stageItemCollected: FLOOR ARTIFACT / an extra dependency joins your build.
ui.finalOvertimeText: FINAL CONFRONTATION / eliminate the privileged process to extract.
ui.sealsDescription: Sealed weapons cannot appear as new upgrades. An operator always keeps their starter.
ui.eggDescription: Each artifact grants one small permanent stat increment to this operator; every eight artifacts completes the same eight-stat cycle.
ui.arsenalOpen: ZERO-DAY VAULT / choose the next primitive.
ui.arsenalFallback: Arsenal saturated. The vault pays out its bounty instead.
ui.arsenalSelected: PRIMITIVE ACQUIRED / the exploit chain grows.
ui.arsenalSkipped: Evidence sold. The vault bounty is secured.
ui.arcanaDraftText: FORBIDDEN PACK / choose one rule to break.

unions.name: Supply Chain Collapse
unions.description: Recon discovers the entry point; a forged JWT supplies the identity. Recon bombardment and returning session tokens become one chain. Consumes Forged JWT and frees one weapon slot.

unions.name: Allocator Sovereign
unions.description: Stack Pivot absorbs Heap Spray: the orbit becomes a fortified carousel while independent bouncing allocations fill the attack surface. Consumes Heap Spray and frees one weapon slot.

unions.name: Crash to Shell
unions.description: Fuzzing Storm absorbs RCE Payload: chain lightning keeps coverage climbing while homing shell payloads explode through the survivors. Consumes RCE Payload and frees one weapon slot.

merchantOffers.name: Cold Backup
merchantOffers.description: Add one revival for this run.

merchantOffers.name: Leaked Grimoire
merchantOffers.description: Acquire a forbidden arcana without waiting for the next timed selection.

merchantOffers.name: Black-Market Arsenal
merchantOffers.description: Choose a new weapon or weapon upgrade. This closes the merchant.

merchantOffers.name: Inverse Snapshot
merchantOffers.description: Inverse exclusive: acquire one additional revival for this run.

merchantOffers.name: Forbidden Call Frame
merchantOffers.description: Inverse exclusive: add one arcana slot and immediately draft from three seeded cards. One extra slot per run.
